name: Joiakim
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return

points: The priestly succession is traced: Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim begat Eliashib, and the line continues through Joiada, Jonathan, and Jaddua.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall

points: In the days of Joiakim the chief of the fathers of each priestly house are named. This is the record kept so the priesthood could be proven by descent, generation after generation.

note.label: Nehemiah 12: The Priests, the Levites, and the Dedication of the Wall
